Tie-break rank from a three-valued consistency verdict

Source: R/taxonomy_agreement.R
taxonomy_tiebreak_rank.Rd

`0` consistent, `1` unknown, `2` inconsistent – so a sort ascending on this rank prefers consistent over unknown over inconsistent. Position the rank AFTER every stronger ordering criterion (recency, confidence tier): it exists to resolve ties, never to override stronger evidence. Measured origin: the isochrones dedup broke ties by lowest NPI, blind to identity quality, and the 2026-09-19 production promotion audit showed the rank changing 360 of 22,002 selections, every one tied on recency and confidence, zero rank regressions.

Usage

taxonomy_tiebreak_rank(consistent)

Arguments

consistent

logical vector from [taxonomy_consistent()].

Value

integer vector of 0/1/2.

See also

Other taxonomy-agreement: TAXONOMY_FAMILY_PATTERNS, taxonomy_consistent(), taxonomy_family_pattern()
